description_en: You can call the ListGrantVSwitchEnis operation to query which elastic network interfaces (ENIs) in a virtual private cloud (VPC) can serve as multicast sources or members
description_zh: 调用ListGrantVSwitchEnis接口查询在一个专有网络内部，哪些弹性网卡的配置可以成为组播源或者组播成员用来进行组播通信

name: ListGrantVSwitchEnis

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance to which the VPC is connected
parameters.help_zh: VPC实例连接的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a vSwitch in the VPC.

You can query information about the ENIs in only one vSwitch at a time
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例下的一个交换机ID。

一次仅支持查询一个交换机下的弹性网卡的信息
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

- If this is your first query, you do not need to specify this parameter.

- If a next query is to be sent, set the value to the NextToken value that was returned from the last call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:

- If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 20.

- If you specify a value greater than 500, the default value is 500
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：
- 当不设置值时，默认值为20。
- 当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The primary private IPv4 address of the ENI
parameters.name: primary_ip_address
